I have previously had positive experiences with other GPs at this surgery; however, my experience since this new doctor joined has been very poor.

I attended two appointments over the course of one month for ongoing and severe back pain. On both occasions, there was no thorough examination or assessment. No medication was prescribed, and I was simply advised to purchase ibuprofen from a pharmacy. There was no investigation, management plan, or follow-up offered despite persistent symptoms.

When a medical sick note was requested due to difficulty continuing work because of pain, this was refused, and I was told to return to work and come back at a later time. This felt dismissive and lacking in appropriate clinical judgement and empathy.

Pain should be taken seriously, even when it is not caused by an obvious injury such as a fracture. Unfortunately, this experience did not meet the standard of care I have previously received at this practice.",null,[0,186]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xaaVl6QkhTblZNYTJsUVMybHdabkZCYkVWMmNVRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x2e33a56cfd764deb!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOlZiYzBHSnVMa2lQS2lwZnFBbEV2cUE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xaaVl6QkhTblZNYTJsUVMybHdabkZCYkVWMmNVRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi-vaKuprKTAxXNNnsEHYJwFxcQoykIBygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwi-vaKuprKTAxXNNnsEHYJwFxcQ0pMFCAUoAQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMUZtUVZkdmVGOWZSV2hEVGpkaGVETkdURlp6VnpkYVZWTjFXVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpUWjBOYVFqaENZV3BGV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xKeGVEZFdObTl5ZVd4M01rMU1WRVZKUjJWYWNsRRAB",["0x0:0x2e33a56cfd764deb",null,1768394584638888,1768997629370177,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/112291210914214346924/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Neelum Mushtaq","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWe_wdRf-kprELBpk1wJySVQG_npdDc9kOkupHgOuSynxxNjPu_=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/112291210914214346924?hl=en"],"112291210914214346924",null,8,2,null,[0,3,1],32,["8 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi-vaKuprKTAxXNNnsEHYJwFxcQ7LoGCAkoAA"]]]],null,"Edited 2 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[3],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Since the new management.
